[USER] User requested recommendations for beginner yoga poses to practice daily.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended 10 beginner yoga poses:  
1. Mountain Pose (Tadasana)  
2. Downward-Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)  
3. Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I)  
4. Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)  
5. Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)  
6. Child’s Pose (Balasana)  
7. Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)  
8. Cobra Pose (Bhujangasana)  
9. Seated Forward Bend (Paschimottanasana)  
10. Easy Pose (Sukhasana)  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to practice poses slowly and safely, focusing on breath and alignment, and to consult a healthcare professional if there are injuries or medical conditions.  
[USER] User expressed a desire to practice yoga daily but mentioned difficulty in sticking to a routine.  
[USER] User requested tips to stay motivated for daily yoga practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided 6 tips to stay motivated:  
1. Set a specific time for practice.  
2. Find a type of yoga that you love.  
3. Consider taking a class for community and accountability.  
4. Keep yoga gear ready and visible.  
5. Visualize success after each practice.  
6. Track progress in a journal or calendar.
